title: Review verdict
description: WO-14b leg 5: the reviewer's mandatory trailing verdict-json block (both Reviewer role files and the codex review runner emit exactly one, additive to the prose report). Parsing is strict — bridge/close.js accepts exactly one such block, valid JSON, schema-valid here; anything else is MALFORMED and the ticket stays open. run_nonce is nullable: it is the codex-lane engine's own per-run token (echoed back so a stale or replayed report cannot wear a fresh run's name) and the Anthropic lane genuinely has none to supply — never fabricate one.

citation_replay.description: The reviewer's OWN self-reported replay; bridge/close.js re-runs every entry through verifier.citationReplay() independently before trusting any of it.

served_model.description: As reported by the host or engine.

run_nonce.description: The engine's per-run nonce (codex lane); null when no engine nonce exists to supply (Anthropic lane).

review.description: Present for registry/load.js's cross-schema invariant (§3.4: cross_family is dispatcher-written, never asserted by the reviewer). bridge/close.js NEVER reads this field — cross_family is computed independently from the two tickets' own author_family — so a reviewer has nothing honest to put here; write null.

cross_family.description: Always null from the reviewer — the dispatcher (bridge/close.js) computes the real value from the ticket pair, not from anything self-reported here.
